native_source_arrays.capture_stage_context: Guarded rank-2/rank-3 snapshots are the first per-tag/per-tile calls. Source pins place momentum operators inside rk_tendency called from the Runge_Kutta_loop; the record itself has no timestep/RK-step identifier. MU snapshots are at the first advance_mu_t call after RK tendency assembly. Rank-1 c1h/c2h files are overwritten on each source call; these INTENT(IN) arrays are immutable in the called code and the final captured hashes match across arms. The matching native run completed only its first 20-second timestep; exact RK ordinal is inferred from source call order, not encoded in the raw files.
native_source_arrays.difference_arithmetic: Captured R32 operands are individually promoted to float64 before source-call subtraction and compatible-source summation; these deltas retain any R32 accumulation rounding already present within the model call.
